objective: Implement the meeting review workflow and task candidate resolution flow so extracted meeting candidates can be reviewed, edited, accepted, merged, rejected, or saved as provisional tasks with durable local state.
success_criteria: Meeting review data needed for candidate task review is persisted locally instead of existing only in transient extraction results.
Task candidate substates are durably tracked and can link to created or merged tasks.
The implementation supports candidate acceptance as new task, merge into existing task, save as provisional task, and rejection.
A meeting review presentation/controller layer exists for transcript, summary, minutes, projects, and candidate task review without bypassing the review gate.
stop_conditions: The task requires full app-shell navigation or platform UI bootstrapping outside the current library package.
The task requires automatic final-task promotion without explicit review actions.
The task requires remote services or sync behavior.
approval_gates: Introducing automatic task promotion from extraction output
Expanding scope into broad app-shell navigation instead of the meeting review workflow
notes: Prefer pure-Dart presentation/controller code because this repo currently exposes library code without visible Flutter app-shell scaffolding.
Keep review gating explicit and local-only.
